title: YAML class resolves a programmatic detector Score
description:
As an operator of a small local control plane, I want a Python Score subclass named in YAML to run as predict() during evaluate accuracy, so that detector-style evaluations do not use Tactus.

Feature: Programmatic detector Score

  Scenario: YAML class resolves
    Given a score YAML whose class names a registered Python Score subclass
    When the scorecard loads that score
    Then predict() runs that class
    And Tactus is not used

  Scenario: Yes No prediction
    Given an Item with ground truth Yes
    When evaluate accuracy scores that Item
    Then a ScoreResult stores Yes or No
